name: Dawarich
short_desc: Self-hosted location tracking - Google Timeline alternative
author: Freika
description: Dawarich is a self-hosted alternative to Google Location History. Track your location history, visualize it on a map, and have complete control over your data.

form_fields.label: Admin Email
form_fields.hint: Email for your admin account (replaces default demo account)

form_fields.label: Admin Password
form_fields.hint: Password for your admin account

form_fields.label: Time Zone
form_fields.hint: e.g., Europe/London, America/New_York, UTC

form_fields.label: Photon API Host
form_fields.hint: Custom Photon API host for self-hosted reverse geocoding

form_fields.label: Photon API Key
form_fields.hint: Photon API key (e.g., from Dawarich Patreon)

form_fields.label: Photon API Use HTTPS
form_fields.hint: Use HTTPS for Photon API requests

form_fields.label: Geoapify API Key
form_fields.hint: API key for Geoapify reverse geocoding service

form_fields.label: Nominatim API Host
form_fields.hint: Custom Nominatim API host for self-hosted reverse geocoding

form_fields.label: Nominatim API Key
form_fields.hint: API key for Nominatim reverse geocoding service

form_fields.label: Nominatim API Use HTTPS
form_fields.hint: Use HTTPS for Nominatim API requests

form_fields.label: Storage Backend
form_fields.hint: Storage backend: local or s3

form_fields.label: OIDC Client ID
form_fields.hint: Client ID from your OIDC provider (Authelia, Authentik, Keycloak, etc.)

form_fields.label: OIDC Client Secret
form_fields.hint: Client secret from your OIDC provider

form_fields.label: OIDC Issuer URL
form_fields.hint: OIDC issuer URL, e.g. https://authentik.example.com/application/o/dawarich/

form_fields.label: OIDC Redirect URI
form_fields.hint: Callback URL, e.g. https://dawarich.example.com/users/auth/openid_connect/callback

form_fields.label: OIDC Provider Name
form_fields.hint: Display name for the OIDC provider on the sign-in page (e.g. Authentik, Authelia)

form_fields.label: OIDC Auto Register
form_fields.hint: Automatically create new users when signing in with OIDC

form_fields.label: Allow Email/Password Registration
form_fields.hint: Allow public email/password registration alongside OIDC

form_fields.label: Allow Email/Password Login
form_fields.hint: Show email/password login form when OIDC is enabled. Set to false to enforce OIDC-only sign-in.

form_fields.label: OIDC PKCE Enabled
form_fields.hint: Enable PKCE for the OIDC flow. Required by some providers that enforce PKCE.

form_fields.label: Metrics Username
form_fields.hint: Username for /metrics endpoint (required to enable Prometheus scraping)

form_fields.label: Metrics Password
form_fields.hint: Password for /metrics endpoint (required to enable Prometheus scraping)

form_fields.label: SMTP Authentication
form_fields.hint: SMTP authentication type, e.g. plain, login, cram_md5 (useful for Office 365 and similar)

form_fields.label: SMTP Open Timeout
form_fields.hint: Seconds to wait when opening an SMTP connection (default: 5)

form_fields.label: SMTP Read Timeout
form_fields.hint: Seconds to wait when reading from an SMTP connection (default: 5)

form_fields.label: Container UID (PUID)
form_fields.hint: Run the container as this user ID (e.g. 1000). Do NOT use the Compose user: field — use this instead.

form_fields.label: Container GID (PGID)
form_fields.hint: Run the container as this group ID (e.g. 1000). Pair with PUID above.

form_fields.label: Domain
form_fields.hint: Public hostname used to build absolute URLs in outgoing emails (no protocol, e.g. dawarich.example.com)

form_fields.label: Distance Unit
form_fields.hint: Distance unit: km or mi

form_fields.label: SMTP Server
form_fields.hint: Your SMTP server hostname

form_fields.label: SMTP Port
form_fields.hint: Your SMTP port (typically 587 for TLS)

form_fields.label: SMTP Username
form_fields.hint: Your SMTP username

form_fields.label: SMTP Password
form_fields.hint: Your SMTP password

form_fields.label: SMTP From
form_fields.hint: Email address to send emails from
